#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string z;
    std::cin >> n >> z;

    int ans[2] = {0};
    int k = 0;    // 0 = outside parentheses, 1 = inside
    int count = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        char c = z[i];
        if (c == '_') {
            if (k == 0) {
                if (count > ans[0])
                    ans[0] = count;
            } else { // k == 1
                if (count > 0)
                    ans[1]++;
            }
            count = 0;
        } else if (c == '(') {
            if (count > ans[0])
                ans[0] = count;
            k = 1;
            count = 0;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            if (count > 0)
                ans[1]++;
            k = 0;
            count = 0;
        } else {
            count++;
        }
    }
    if (count > ans[0] && k == 0)
        ans[0] = count;

    std::cout << ans[0] << " " << ans[1] << "\n";
    return 0;
}
